//: The year: four seasons, the sun and the temperature curve. Prologue design values (decided 26.09.2026): 91-day seasons as on Earth, a temperate north-eastern climate, everything derived from the run's seed and the minute so that nothing here is ever saved. Code: src/game/time/Calendar.js, src/game/weather/Climate.js.

calendar.//startWindow: A new run wakes on a seeded day inside this window (season, first day, last day): the second half of summer, so the cold is never far.

sun.//: Day length is a cosine over the year: `meanHours` +/- `amplitudeHours`, longest on `longestYearDay` (early summer). Solar noon at `noonHour`. Night begins at sunset and ends at sunrise; full day begins `dayAfterSunriseHours` after sunrise; evening is the last `eveningHours` before sunset. Summer therefore keeps roughly the old fixed 20:00-05:00 night and winter has sixteen hours of dark.
sun.//dawnLeadMinutes: The picture brightens this long before sunrise (the rules' night still ends at sunrise): by the time night is over, the land is already in view. Dusk already darkens through the evening hour before sunset.

climate.//: airC = seasonal mean (sine) + seeded daily anomaly (a persistent random walk) + cold snaps / warm spells + the day's swing + the weather's own delta + the ground's delta.

spells.//: Fronts of several days, seeded by day. chancePerDay is the chance a front begins on a day none is running; days and deltaC are [min, max] ranges.

signs.//: One-time messages for what the survivor can see, said at sunrise on the first day each is true (never in advance: there is no forecast). The words live in the game repo (src/game/weather/Seasons.js) keyed by these ids; leave an id out to silence it. nights_drawing_in: the first day the sun sets before nightsDrawingInSunsetBefore (minutes of the day; 1110 = 18:30, early autumn). first_frost: the first dawn under climate.frostC. birches_bare: the first day of late autumn. first_snow: the first day with 1 cm or more lying. water_frozen / thaw: the ice forms / the ice goes. a_year: the first day of the run's second year.
